task: A2/T4 sensor drop-event log + quality trends

definitions.drop_event: fill decrease >=25 raw units between consecutive valid (0..100) readings, gap <=24 h, 'before' reading not adjacent (+/-1 reading) to a negative-code episode
definitions.agreement: driver record matched to nearest valid sensor reading within +/-3 h; agree if |driver - sensor/ceiling*100| <= 25
definitions.stamped_emptying: distinct (container, idrecolha) driver record with timestamp, instrumented bins only
definitions.families: small = -1..-9, large = -10..-116 (convention from R2-01 Rev C)

findings: Sensors registered 47,093 drop events (fill fall >=25 units within 24 h) against 36,001 stamped driver emptyings on the same instrumented bins - the sensor stream sees roughly 1.3 drop events per stamped emptying, so many emptyings (and some non-collection disturbances) are visible only in the sensor data.

Negative error codes make up 9.2% of all sensor rows overall, split between the small family (-1..-9) and the large family (-10..-116, dominated by -116); the yearly share varies (see negatives_by_year), so per-year exposure corrections are needed.

Record-level driver-vs-sensor agreement (+/-3 h nearest reading, within 25 points of the ceiling-normalized fill) is 49.0% overall and varies by year - consistent with the earlier finding that the two instruments are not interchangeable.
